Foreign credit cards now work with Alipay and WeChat Pay, but with limitations. For full features, a Chinese bank account is helpful but not always required.
hard.is.it.safe.to.use.mobile.payments.i: Is it safe to use mobile payments in China?
hard.yes.mobile.payments.in.china.are.ve: Yes, mobile payments in China are very secure. Alipay and WeChat have millions of users with strong security measures. Use biometric verification for large transactions.
hard.how.much.cash.should.i.bring.to.chi: How much cash should I bring to China?
For emergencies, carry 500-1000 CNY equivalent in local currency. Most urban places accept mobile payment. Rural areas may need more cash.
hard.can.i.get.a.tax.refund.on.purchases: Can I get a tax refund on purchases in China?
hard.yes.you.can.get.vat.refund.on.purch: Yes, you can get VAT refund on purchases over 200 CNY at participating stores. Keep the invoice and get the tax refund form at the store before departure.
hard.what.atms.should.i.use.in.china: What ATMs should I use in China?
